READ	SELECT col1 + 1 AS a FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY a ORDER BY col1 + 1
READ	SELECT col1 + 1 AS a, a AS b FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY a ORDER BY col1 + 1
READ	SELECT col1 + 1 AS a FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY a HAVING col1 + 1 > 0
READ	SELECT col1 + 1 AS a, a AS b FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY a HAVING col1 + 1 > 0
READ	SELECT col1, col2, GROUPING(col1) FROM VALUES("abc", 1) GROUP BY CUBE(col1, col2) ORDER BY GROUPING(col1)
READ	SELECT col1, col2, GROUPING(col1) FROM VALUES("abc", 1) GROUP BY CUBE(col1, col2) HAVING GROUPING(col1) != NULL

READ	SELECT col1 AS a, col1 FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY col1 HAVING col1 > 0
READ	SELECT col2 AS b, col2 FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY ALL
READ	SELECT col2 AS b, col2 FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING col2 > 0 ORDER BY ALL
READ	SELECT col2 AS b, col2, b as c FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY ALL
READ	SELECT col2 AS b, col2, b as c FROM VALUES(1,2) GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING col2 > 0 ORDER BY ALL
